structured_output.summary:
Fixed in `src/ui/start-screen.ts`. The menu could leave a card selected after that card became locked again. Now `show()` re-reads the locks and best laps through `refresh()`, then checks the current selection. If the selected card is now locked, the selection moves to the first unlocked card using the existing `pick()`. Pine Ridge is then no longer aria-checked, and RACE no longer starts a locked track. The check is in `show()` and not in `refresh()`, because `refresh()` first runs before `selected` is set. I also updated the `tracks` option comment to say "first unlocked".

New test: `tests/ui/relocked-selection.test.ts` (the verifier's test). It failed before the fix (aria-checked was 'true') and passes after. `pnpm typecheck` passes.

`pnpm test` did not pass cleanly. Two full runs each failed a few Chromium browser tests: 4 on the first run and 6 on the second, and the failing set changed between runs (desktop-hud, hud-motion, keycap, results-fit-phone, track-card-press). All 10 passed when I re-ran them on their own, so they look like load-related flakes. I couldn't check them on the code without my change, because the working tree isn't a git repository. The other 845 tests passed on both runs.
